app.yaml:
apiVersion: software.sovereign-os/v1
kind: App
name: 'Orders'
description: 'Orders - a Next.js web app built from the Sovereign OS golden path.'
surface: both
template: nextjs-web
declares:
  connections: []
  data: []
  knowledge: []
openapi.yaml:
openapi: 3.0.3
info: { title: Orders, version: 0.1.0 }
paths:
  /api/functions/classify-order:
    post:
      operationId: classify_order
      summary: Decide whether an order amount needs review.
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { type: object, required: [amount], properties: { amount: { type: number } } }
      responses:
        "200": { description: The classification }
  /api/orders:
    post:
      operationId: add_order
      summary: Add an order (governed write, runs as the caller).
      responses:
        "201": { description: The stored record }
  /api/ask:
    post:
      operationId: ask_review_agent
      summary: Run the review agent system and return its run state.
      responses:
        "200": { description: The agent run }
actions.yml:
actions:
  - name: classify_order
    description: Decide whether an order amount needs review (above the review limit) or is standard.
    write: false
    scopes: [records]
    input:
      amount: number
